description: Test suite for provider-usage.shared module functions and utility methods related to provider ID normalization, percentage clamping, timeout handling, and legacy Pi auth token retrieval.

methods.name: async function withLegacyPiAuthFile( withLegacyPiAuthFile

methods.name: resolveUsageProviderId
methods.description: Normalizes provider IDs, converting to lowercase and removing specific suffixes.

methods.name: clampPercent
methods.description: Clamps a number to the range 0 to 100, treating NaN and infinite as 0.

methods.name: withTimeout
